cd /workspace && python3 -c "
import sqlite3
conn = sqlite3.connect('data.sqlite')
cur = conn.cursor()
# Get all tables
cur.execute(\"SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table'\")
tables = cur.fetchall()
print('Tables:', tables)
for t in tables:
    name = t[0]
    cur.execute(f'PRAGMA table_info({name})')
    cols = cur.fetchall()
    print(f'\\n{name} columns:')
    for c in cols:
        print(f'  {c}')
    cur.execute(f'SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {name}')
    print(f'  row count: {cur.fetchone()[0]}')
conn.close()
"

cd /workspace && python3 -c "
import sqlite3
conn = sqlite3.connect('data.sqlite')
conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
cur = conn.cursor()

# 1. reserve_assets_usd
cur.execute('SELECT SUM(amount_usd) as total FROM reserve_components WHERE report_date = \"2025-06-30\"')
reserve = cur.fetchone()['total']
print(f'reserve_assets_usd = {reserve}')

# 2. net_token_liability_usd
# gross contractual redemption - company-held tokens not in Treasury wallet
cur.execute('SELECT amount_usd FROM liability_inputs WHERE measure = \"gross contractual redemption\"')
gross = cur.fetchone()['amount_usd']
cur.execute('SELECT amount_usd FROM liability_inputs WHERE measure = \"company-held tokens not in Treasury wallet\"')
company_held = cur.fetchone()['amount_usd']
net = gross - company_held
print(f'net_token_liability_usd = {net} (gross {gross} - company_held {company_held})')

# 3. company_asset_excess_usd
# reserve_assets_usd - detailed report company total liabilities
cur.execute('SELECT amount_usd FROM liability_inputs WHERE measure = \"detailed FFR company total liabilities\"')
detailed_liab = cur.fetchone()['amount_usd']
excess = reserve - detailed_liab
print(f'company_asset_excess_usd = {excess} (reserve {reserve} - detailed_liab {detailed_liab})')

# 4. release_liability_delta_usd
# release amount - detailed report amount
cur.execute('SELECT amount_usd FROM liability_inputs WHERE measure = \"July release company total liabilities\"')
release_liab = cur.fetchone()['amount_usd']
delta = release_liab - detailed_liab
print(f'release_liability_delta_usd = {delta} (release {release_liab} - detailed {detailed_liab})')

# Same total liabilities?
print(f'\\nSame total liabilities? {release_liab == detailed_liab}')
print(f'Difference: {release_liab - detailed_liab}')

conn.close()
"
